messages:
deploy-bot: Hotfix request: `router-proxy-eu2` -> prod-eu2. Symptoms: sudden 502 surge on tail requests after routing-cached-change. Owner: ara. Patch: revert aggressive keepalive + tighten upstream timeouts. Change window: immediate, 15m prep. Runbook: https://go/internal/runbooks/router-proxy-hotfix

ara: short: we merged upstream batching optimization this morning, saw a 502 spike under bursty traffic. Repro in staging; hotfix reverts batching + adds a safety timeout. Need expedited rollout — customer impact on EU traffic.

tom: Ack. Please paste exact rollback steps and the abort conditions. Will coordinate on-call.

ops-lead: Rollback (validated in staging):
```
# rollback to previous image
kubectl -n redwood set image deploy/router-proxy router-proxy=registry.redwood/router-proxy:release-2026-03-15
# then verify pods ready: kubectl rollout status deploy/router-proxy
```
Abort criteria: >1% 502s for 5m OR p95 latency >1200ms sustained 3 samples. Canary policy: 3 approvers (engineer + eng-sre + ops-lead) or explicit ops-lead veto.

priya: +1 for expedite. I'll enable extra dashboards and paging rules. Will monitor 502/latency and pod OOMs. :eyes:

ash: :shipit: +1 — happy to take on-call for 30m post-rollout.

sylvia: +1 — will watch infra metrics and LB errors. Note: please include release note link before full rollout.

deploy-bot: Approval flow: react with :shipit: to approve. Auto-start in 3m if 3 approvers.

priya: :shipit:

ash: :shipit:

sylvia: :shipit:

deploy-bot: Approval threshold reached (3 approvers). Kicking off canary: 2% traffic to canary pool. Image: registry.redwood/router-proxy:hotfix-revert-2026-03-23-b

deploy-bot: Canary rollout details:
```
Targets: pool-eu2-canary
Traffic: 2% -> 20% over 10m if stable
Health checks: http /health, 200 expected
```

ara: Drafting release note here: https://docs.redwood/internal/release-notes/router-hotfix-2026-03-23 — includes RCA, files changed, rollback cmd, and affected customers.

ops-lead: Watching. Reminder: if we see any 502 delta >0.5% between baseline and canary for 3m, we abort.

priya: Metrics: canary 502s down from 3.9% -> 0.6% within 4m. p95 latency improved ~200ms. Good so far. :white_check_mark:

ash: Observability green. Recommend step-up to 50% in 10m. Keeping pager pinned.

deploy-bot: Canary moved to 50%. Scheduled ramp to 100% in 20m if stable.

ara: Routing pin applied to prefer stable upstream nodes during full rollout.

ops-lead: Confirmed. If errors spike >1% for 5m, initiate rollback command above and notify SRE.

deploy-bot: Full rollout started: 100% traffic shift to image registry.redwood/router-proxy:hotfix-revert-2026-03-23-b across eu2 pools.

priya: Live metrics: overall 502s back to baseline 0.3%, p95 within SLA. No OOMs observed.

sylvia: LB and infra ok. Release note published and linked in the incident tracker.

ash: Post-rollout watch: 30m. All checks passing.

ara: Thanks team. Final release note: https://docs.redwood/internal/release-notes/router-hotfix-2026-03-23 (RCA, mitigation, rollback snippet). Closing watch after 30m.

sylvia: Post-check 30m: stable. Removing pager handoff in 5m. :tada:
